Request sent. Look at the Photos face on your watch, re-enable the plugin, then reconnect in the companion app.
Remove request sent. Check the Photos face on your watch, then restore the plugin and reconnect in the companion app.

• Sending makes the Photos face the current one. • The watch’s answer goes to the stock plugin, so this app can only say the request was sent. • Galaxy Wearable may not list photos sent from here, and saving its Photos screen may replace them. • The face’s clock type and colour are left as they are; change them on the watch. • The Photos face has to be in the watch’s face list. It comes with the watch, but it can be removed there.
